name: production
description: Production posture with one recorded exception: the landing target may be a line whose open-source support window has closed.

exception.rationale: The application depends on Spring Cloud. The newest Spring Boot lines have no GA Spring Cloud release train, and the newest line that does have one has just passed its open-source support date. Landing on a supported-ecosystem line that is briefly past its OSS window is a smaller risk than landing on a line with no ecosystem support at all. This exception is recorded here rather than hidden, and Agent 18 raises a SHORT_HORIZON_TARGET approval gate for it.
exception.expires: review at the next Spring Cloud GA release train
